BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, and it is strength: the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, 'The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.' It is the force a people finds in one another when God is their God — the strength of Jerusalem resting in the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for strength in one verse carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the promise — the people of Jerusalem will be each other's strength because the LORD of hosts is their God.
